question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Stingy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Stingy"** means someone who is unwilling to spend money or share resources. (कंजूस)
 
 
• **Example:** He is so stingy that he never tips the waiter.
 
 
 
• **"Generous"** refers to someone who is willing to give more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her generous donations to charity.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'stingy'** is **'generous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deceitful** (धोखेबाज): Tending to deceive or cheat.
 
 
• **Example:** His deceitful nature makes it hard to trust him.
 
 
 
• **Lascivious** (कामुक): Inclined to lustfulness; lewd.
 
 
• **Example:** The lascivious comments made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Humorous** (हास्यपूर्ण): Funny or entertaining.
 
 
• **Example:** His humorous anecdotes always make us laugh.
